lines.zh: 披风扫过地面，我走得稳。
lines.en: My cape sweeps the ground. Steady steps.

lines.zh: 长长的披风是累赘也是招牌。
lines.en: The long cape is a burden and a badge.

lines.zh: 触角贴着额头，风一吹就响。
lines.en: My antennae hum when the wind hits.

lines.zh: 我走得不快，但每一步都准。
lines.en: I'm not fast, but every step is exact.

lines.zh: 绿皮肤在树影里最好藏。
lines.en: Green skin hides well in leaf shade.

lines.zh: 绕着空地走一圈，看看边界。
lines.en: One lap of the clearing to check its edge.
My footsteps make almost no sound.

lines.zh: 这具身体比记忆里的更沉。
lines.en: This body is heavier than memory.
The robe hem trips you — I hold it up.
Into the shade, then out again.

lines.zh: 前方没人，但我照样警惕。
lines.en: Empty ahead, but I stay wary.
Sitting cross-legged, my ki settles.
I'm meditating — and listening.

lines.zh: 触角能感到空气的变化。
lines.en: The antennae feel the change in the air.
The cape flaps softly in the wind.
This body doesn't need sleep.

lines.zh: 我在算这具躯壳的极限。
lines.en: Calculating this shell's limits.
Silence serves better than words.

lines.zh: 气在体内循环，一圈又一圈。
lines.en: Ki circles inside me, round and round.

lines.zh: 这具克隆的眼睛看得更远。
lines.en: These cloned eyes see farther.

lines.zh: 我压着力量，不让它溢出来。
lines.en: I hold the power back, keep it inside.
A droplet falls somewhere far off.

lines.zh: 冥想被打断了，就从开头重来。
lines.en: Interrupted meditation — start from the beginning.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸很慢，几乎无声。
lines.en: My breath is slow, nearly silent.
My shadow is very long.
You stand there with a thin aura.

lines.zh: 你身上有一种活着的气味。
lines.en: You carry the smell of being alive.

lines.zh: 我在判断你要不要动手。
lines.en: Judging whether you'll strike.
Your eyes keep sliding away.

lines.zh: 这具身体看你，像看一块石头。
lines.en: This body sees you as a stone.
Say what you want. Directly.
I don't make small talk.
Not one extra step.
My patience is running thin.
You're wounded. And still here?
There needn't be hostility between us.

lines.zh: 你呼吸乱了，我知道你怕。
lines.en: Your breath broke. I know you're afraid.

lines.zh: 把武器放下，我们不一定要打。
lines.en: Set the weapon down. We needn't fight.

lines.zh: 你看起来不像这片林子的人。
lines.en: You don't look like you belong in these woods.
I warn once.
My ki scattered. I need to regather.
That rattled into the bone.
A tear across my cape.
One step back, hand on the wound.
This body's pain feels real.
Blood on green skin.
My breath broke for only a moment.
Don't think that ends it.
I can still gather my ki again.
Stand, draw the ki back in.
Take it away. Don't wave it near me.
Water, yes. Food, no.

lines.zh: 这具身体对食物没兴趣。
lines.en: This body has no interest in food.

lines.zh: 这具克隆的嘴，尝不出味道。
lines.en: This clone's mouth cannot taste anything.
I sense smell more than taste.
Real hunger isn't in the stomach.
Put it down, then walk away.
Don't test me with that.

lines.zh: 当年我也会饿，现在不同。
lines.en: I used to get hungry. Not anymore.
You touched my cape.
Keep distance. My temper's short.
Step back or my palm comes up.
It's not that I can't hit — I don't want to.
I'm standing here. Don't crowd.

lines.zh: 你撞过来的时候气乱了。
lines.en: Your aura scrambled when you hit me.
I'm heavier than I look.
Move aside. I'm walking through.
Don't press against me. Something will happen.
Try pushing once more.

lines.zh: 我已没什么可以传下去。
lines.en: I've little left to pass on.
A cloned body can't do that.

lines.zh: 我的路只有修炼和战斗。
lines.en: My path is only training and combat.
Don't raise that.
This shell is hollow.
I'm long past that age.
What's left belongs to others.
I don't care to explain that.
Silence is my answer.
Ask someone else that question.

lines.zh: 地上这枚石子有点意思。
lines.en: This pebble has an odd shape.
I pick it up because it's there.
Cloth — enough to patch the cape.
I recognize this herb.
Pocket it. It may serve.

lines.zh: 不是所有东西都该拿走。
lines.en: Not everything should be taken.

lines.zh: 我弯下腰，披风垂到地上。
lines.en: Bending, my cape falls to the ground.
Keep this shard.
You dropped this. Take it back.
Picked up. Move on. Ask nothing.
Your aura leaked.
Marked. Don't try to hide yourself.
So you mean to fight.
Good distance. Good angle.
You shouldn't stand in the open.
These eyes are good enough.
My palm raised is my answer.
You're already late, right now.
Think before you move.

lines.zh: 我看得见你背后的冷汗。
lines.en: I can see the cold sweat on your back.
I'll close your way first.
Your aura is pulling back.
I'll take this fight.

lines.zh: 你不是我的对手，但可以试试。
lines.en: You're no match — but try.
I'm set. Come at me.
I gather ki without a sign.
Half a step closer is dangerous.
There's a flaw in your stance.
Raise your arm too early and I'll read it.
You strike first; then I answer.
Ki is pressed into my palm.
He stepped back, not away.
That angle won't block a ki blast.

lines.zh: 我脚下一挪，你就要重算。
lines.en: One shift of my foot and you must recalculate.
Breathe. Steady. Don't rush.
The wind in this forest favors me.
Your left hand hasn't moved once.
I'm a moment ahead of you.
Don't go behind that tree.
My ki has gathered enough.
One breath more — the perfect moment.
You're already in my rhythm.
Palm strike to the chest!
This elbow comes from below.
Ki wraps around my fist.

lines.zh: 挡得住一刀，挡不住这一下。
lines.en: You can block a blade, not this.
Kick the knee, bring him low.
Three strikes, each pressing in.
My cape will fool your eyes.
This body is half a beat ahead.
Ki blast pushed from my palm.
He sidesteps — I turn and re-enter.
That strike used only three parts of ten.
Don't back to the tree — no room.
The moment we touch, the ki bursts.
Parry his weapon, then strike.
I've practiced this a long time.
Recover. Keep distance.
I rise out of stillness.
The cape settles. I open my eyes.

lines.zh: 这具克隆的躯壳开始运转。
lines.en: This cloned shell starts to turn.
Ki moves first; awareness follows.
I stand between shadow and light.
My antennae quiver.
Someone has made a me of me.

lines.zh: 我打量这具陌生的身体。
lines.en: I survey this unfamiliar body.
The air here is unfamiliar.
I sense ki far off.
Feet set, cape falling straight.
A pause. Then movement.
This body is sturdier than expected.
I reach out and try a fist.

lines.zh: 天空的颜色和我记得不同。
lines.en: The sky's color differs from memory.
I listen first, then look.

lines.zh: 我站着，等这躯壳完全醒。
lines.en: I stand and let the shell fully wake.
A voice inside — is it mine?
Flame is roasting my cape.

lines.zh: 落地时膝盖先撞上石头。
lines.en: My knee hit stone on landing.

lines.zh: 水压着我的胸口，气乱了。
lines.en: Water crushes my chest — ki scatters.
The blast tore my cape in two.
Something sharp found my shoulder.
That spell is testing my will.

lines.zh: 这躯壳在空转，越来越弱。
lines.en: This shell idles, growing weaker.
The lightning numbed my antennae.
I sink, and my ki scatters.
